Cabana Bass Productions is dragging you down the rabbit hole and there's no climbing back out 🐇🔊

Friday, July 24 — Main Floor transforms into a twisted wonderland where bass hits like a fever dream and techno bends reality sideways. Drink Me. Follow the smoke. Lose yourself in it.

This isn't your childhood storybook. This is Alice in BASS Land — blood on the cards, mushrooms glowing, and a soundsystem built to rattle your ribcage. Nothing about this reality is normal, and that's exactly the point.

Mark it. Tell your people. This one sells out the wonderland fast 🕳️✨

Fog rolling across the floor. Blue liquid glowing in a glass bottle. A bassline that sounds like it's whispering follow me 🌀🖤

This is what Alice in Bass Land feels like before you even step inside — the air already thick with anticipation, the lights already bending wrong, the first drop already living rent-free in your chest.

Cabana Bass Productions doesn't do subtle. Expect visuals that mess with your head, a crowd that melts into one moving thing, and a soundtrack built entirely for full-body immersion. Techno pulses. Bass rattles your teeth. Time stops making sense somewhere around 1AM.

Drink Me. Just don't expect to remember the whole night the same way twice 🍄💊

Come as your most unhinged wonderland self — mad hatters, bloody Alices, cheshire grins, whatever your brain conjures at 2am scrolling Pinterest 🃏🌹

Alice in Bass Land isn't about fitting a theme perfectly. It's about showing up as your full weird self and finding a floor full of people doing exactly the same. Cabana Bass Productions built this night for the ones who live for a little chaos, a little glitter, a lot of bass.

Mi gente, this is your Friday. Bring your best twisted-fairytale look or just bring yourself — either way the wonderland doesn't care, it just wants your energy on that Main Floor.

Strangers tonight, wonderland family by the last drop 🖤🍷
